# Muelle

> Muelle is a free, MIT-licensed dock for Windows 11 written in Rust. It hides the Windows taskbar and replaces it with a macOS-style dock: icons that grow under the cursor, minimized windows as live thumbnails, drag and drop onto apps, and an optional top menu bar. A small guardian process gives the taskbar back if the dock quits or crashes.

Muelle is not an Electron or Tauri app: the dock is a native Win32 process that draws through the Windows composition engine. One idle snapshot in Windows Task Manager showed 3.1 MB for the grouped Muelle processes; this point-in-time reading can vary by system and session. It excludes the separate Settings window and its WebView2 runtime.

## Pages

- [Home](https://muellee.vercel.app/): what Muelle is, how the dock behaves, features and screenshots.
- [How it works](https://muellee.vercel.app/#how): the dock's behaviour step by step.
- [Features](https://muellee.vercel.app/#features): glass material, magnification, live thumbnails, menu bar, safety.
- [Install](https://muellee.vercel.app/#install): one-step installer, building from source, and how to get the taskbar back.

## Download

- [Muelle-Setup.exe](https://github.com/crafter-station/Muelle/releases/latest/download/Muelle-Setup.exe): Windows 11, 64-bit, per user, no administrator rights.
- [All releases](https://github.com/crafter-station/Muelle/releases): version history and notes.

The installer is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may ask for confirmation (More info → Run anyway).

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/crafter-station/Muelle): Rust workspace. The dock is `apps/dock`, the settings window is `apps/settings` (Tauri 2 + React).
- [License](https://github.com/crafter-station/Muelle/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT.
- [Issues](https://github.com/crafter-station/Muelle/issues): bug reports and feature requests.

## Facts

- Platform: Windows 11 (single monitor is the supported case).
- Idle memory: 3.1 MB shown for the grouped Muelle processes in one Windows Task Manager snapshot; this is not a guaranteed value and excludes Settings/WebView2.
- Idle CPU: 0% in that snapshot; the dock uses no periodic timers while idle.
- Installer: about 2.4 MB, one step, no wizard and no admin rights.
- Uninstall or quit: the Windows taskbar comes back, and uninstalling leaves Windows as it was.
- Not affiliated with Apple or Microsoft; the visual language is inspired by macOS, the icons and code are original.
